page.layout: Top: three columns of index entries (continuation, "Vita" to "Zelus"), no heading. Below them, a centred title in capitals, "INDEX LOCORVM SACRAE SCRIPTVRAE..." with a subtitle over two lines. Below the title, three columns of scripture references: column 1 (Genesis to Numeri), column 2 (Deuteronomium to Psalmorum), column 3 (Psalms to the catchword). Catchword and signature at the lower right. No margin notes.
